notes: Prices are the providers' public list prices in US dollars, without VAT or sales tax.
Hetzner bills a primary IPv4 separately: ipv4_extra_month_usd holds it, and price_month_with_ipv4_usd adds it so every provider's price includes one public IPv4.
Vultr and DigitalOcean charge the same everywhere a plan is offered; Linode and Hetzner price some locations higher.
GPU, bare metal, free-tier and deprecated plans are left out.
